title: Python: wire delegation_tokens into root DAO validation per spec 8.7.2
description: python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py (COSE_Sign1 create/verify/scope, spec 18.8.6) exists but nothing consumes it. python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py validates DAOs (validate_and_process_dao_wire_at) and enforces the .44.7 self-/128 profile only (dao_manager.py:869-886: multiple_target, target_mismatch); there is no delegation cache and no sub-/128 target path. Implement spec 8.7.2 root-validation steps: on DAO Target prefix != origin /128, lookup delegation for (target_prefix, target_prefix_len); reject expired/missing/E-flag-mismatched delegations before route or replay mutation; cache keyed by (prefix, prefix_len) with delegation_seq monotonicity. Keep /0 denied (spec 8.7.1: only exact ::/0 delegation ever authorizes, reserved for generalized-profile work). Add table-driven allow/deny tests mirroring rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs (self /128 allow, foreign /128 deny, /0 deny, broad undelegated deny, delegated allow once cache is seeded). Decomposed from project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2.
close_reason: Implemented spec 8.7.2 root DAO prefix-delegation authorization (commit 15a03b21b1). delegation_tokens.py: added PrefixDelegationTokenPayload/PrefixDelegationToken (spec 8.7.2 CBOR payload keys 1-6, E-flag bit0, reserved bits zero), create_prefix_delegation_token + verify_prefix_delegation_token reusing the module COSE_Sign1/Schnorr48 core. dao_manager.py: install_prefix_delegation() verifies token vs root identity (sig, IID binding, expiry, per-key delegation_seq monotonicity), rejects /0 (default_route) and caps table at 64 (delegation_capacity); _authorize_delegated_target() wired at the step-4 authenticated target boundary in _apply_dao_at_unlocked BEFORE any route/replay/persistence mutation: foreign /128 without delegation keeps the vector-pinned target_mismatch reason (test/vectors/dao_origin_signature.json coverage=target_mismatch stays green), else delegate_mismatch/delegation_expired/delegation_external_flag, exact (canonical prefix, prefix_len) lookup. Sub-/128 and /0 Targets are rejected at the .44.7 wire profile (malformed_option) before authorization, mirroring Rust InvalidOptionLength-before-authorize; a seeded /64 delegation cannot relax the wire profile. Tests: python/tests/rpl/test_dao_prefix_authorization.py, 12 table-driven tests mirroring rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs (self /128 allow, foreign /128 deny, /0 deny, broad undelegated deny, delegated allow after seeding with zero-mutation + floor-advance proofs, delegate binding, expiry, external transit, install fail-closed, capacity+seq monotonicity). Fixtures use create_prefix_delegation_token as round-trip/wiring only; token codec oracle suites tests/crypto/test_delegation_tokens*.py (31 tests) remain green. Verification: touched + dao/delegation suites 916 passed; tests/rpl+tests/crypto+test_vectors.py 2119 passed, 7 pre-existing failures unrelated to this change (test_short_addr_derive_vector, test_dad_hash_algorithm_resolution; exist at HEAD per f099357cb8). ruff format + check clean. Note: delegated sub-/128 routes stay unrouteable pending the .44.9 generalized profile (Python routing table is /128-only); authorization API is prefix-len-general.
